core_obligations: Reduce to the case where M is represented by a complex F^bullet of I-torsion free modules, using the construction of L-eta_I, and identify L-eta_I M tensor^L O_X/I as represented by eta_I F^bullet tensor O_X/I, while H^bullet(M/I) has terms H^i(F^bullet tensor I^i/I^{i+1}) (proof lines 14442-14452).

Construct the map levelwise: for a local generator f of I and a local section s = f^i s' of (eta_I F)^i, show d^i(s) = f^{i+1}t maps to zero in F^{i+1} tensor I^i/I^{i+1}, so s may be sent to the class of f^i s' in H^i(F^bullet tensor I^i/I^{i+1}) (proof lines 14455-14468).

Verify that these levelwise maps are compatible with the differentials, using that the Bockstein sends the class of f^i s' to the class of f^{i+1} t, and obtain a map of complexes representing the arrow of the statement (proof lines 14469-14472).
Identify the resulting map with the algebraic one by comparing stalks with the cited More on Algebra lemma, which concludes the proof (proof lines 14474-14478).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to an I-torsion free representative and rewrite both sides.
Define the levelwise map from the explicit form of sections of eta_I F.
Check compatibility with differentials and conclude by a stalkwise comparison with the algebraic model.
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the canonical isomorphism L-eta_I M tensor^L O_X/I = H^bullet(M/I) in D(O_X), where the right-hand side is the Bockstein complex. The proof reduces to I-torsion free representatives using the construction of L-eta, computes the tensor product as eta_I F^bullet tensor O_X/I, then writes a local generator f of I and a local section s = f^i s' and shows that d^i maps it to zero in F^{i+1} tensor I^i/I^{i+1}, which yields a map of complexes to H^i(F^bullet tensor I^i/I^{i+1}) (proof lines 14442-14472). Compatibility with differentials is a calculation, and the identification with the algebraic model is made stalkwise (proof lines 14474-14478). H2: the explicit section-level construction of the map and the differential check are the substance; there is no missing argument.
